result.topic_en: Brief lecture-style notes on mechanics, apparently covering the reversion pendulum (equal-period axes, length of the equivalent mathematical pendulum), the relation between oscillation period and the acceleration of fall, cycloidal oscillation, clocks as an application, pendulum and falling motion, circular/centrifugal motion, and laws of impact; the reading is highly uncertain.
